label: acousticness
definition: Confidence from 0 to 1 that the audio is acoustic.

label: audio confidence
definition: verified: Spotify's values via ReccoBeats. estimated: tempo and energy from previews.

label: Spotify streams
definition: Total Spotify streams at the latest snapshot.

label: danceability
definition: How suitable the audio is for dancing, from 0 to 1.

label: display name
definition: The person's name for display, without a Wikipedia disambiguator.

label: energy
definition: Intensity and activity.

label: first release date
definition: The earliest known release date.

label: first release precision
definition: year, month or day: how much of a recording's first release date is known.

label: first week
definition: The first week of a chart run.

label: growth acceleration
definition: This 90-day growth rate minus the previous one.

label: has a revival
definition: The revival month at least doubled the song's usual level (revival score of 1 or more).

label: has tracklist
definition: Apple lists the tracks on the release.

label: Hot 100 peak
definition: The song's highest Billboard Hot 100 position.

label: Hot 100 weeks
definition: The weeks the song has spent on the Billboard Hot 100.

label: instrumentalness
definition: Confidence from 0 to 1 that the audio has no vocals.

label: BTS featured
definition: BTS appears as a featured artist.

label: has a generic title
definition: Titled Intro, Outro, Skit or Interlude with nothing else.

label: is a single
definition: Wikipedia lists the song as a single.

label: is a video recording
definition: MusicBrainz marks the recording as a video.

label: key
definition: The estimated key of the audio, as a pitch class.

label: last week
definition: The last week of a chart run.

label: length
definition: The length of the recording.

label: liveness
definition: Presence of a live audience.

label: long tail
definition: Percentile of 2025 streams per day among songs released before 2023: the dataset's one measure of staying power.

label: loudness
definition: The overall loudness of the audio.

label: member writer share
definition: Share of a song's writers who are members.

label: metric
definition: What is measured: streams, daily, rank or views.

label: mode
definition: 1 = major, 0 = minor.

label: music video growth
definition: Last 90 days' video views per day against the 90 before, minus 1.

label: music video views
definition: Total official music video views at the latest snapshot.

label: music video views per day
definition: Average daily official music video views over the last 90 days.

label: name
definition: Name as credited.

label: observed at
definition: The date the analysis was obtained.

label: peak position
definition: The highest position of a chart run.

label: platform
definition: spotify or deezer.

label: popularity
definition: Percentile of streams per day among songs that have it.

label: producers
definition: The people credited as producer on the song.

label: month published
definition: The month the video was published.

label: release age
definition: The time from the song's first release to the latest snapshot.

label: release date
definition: The date the release came out.

label: result
definition: The value read on that date.

label: revival month
definition: The month of the song's largest surge.

label: revival score
definition: Largest monthly surge against the song's prior six-month median, net of the same surge for songs a year or more old. Songs a year or more old with at least 5,000 streams per day.

label: slug
definition: Readable identifier, unique per table.

label: speechiness
definition: Presence of spoken words, such as rap.

label: stream growth
definition: Last 90 days' streams per day against the 90 before, minus 1.

label: streams per day
definition: Average daily Spotify streams over the last 90 days.

label: streams per day in 2025
definition: Average daily Spotify streams in 2025, for songs released by then with data on at least 75% of its days. The basis of long_tail_score.

label: tempo
definition: The estimated tempo of the audio.

label: title
definition: The title as its source gives it.

label: Korean title
definition: The song's Korean title, where it has one.

label: track count
definition: The number of tracks Apple lists on the release.

label: valence
definition: Musical positiveness.

label: version
definition: original, live, remix, instrumental, demo, japanese, korean, alternate or atmos.

label: version label
definition: The version as the source words it, such as 'V demo ver.'.

label: video kind
definition: mv, dance_practice, lyric_video, teaser, performance or other.

label: weeks on chart
definition: The number of weeks in a chart run.

label: writers
definition: The people credited as writer on the song.
